meta.evidence_class: simulation (sim_hr, continuous local law, nominal plant) against the floating-point certificate of certify_fb at 20 ms

design: FB (feedback-only followers, shaped head reference); lam = 0.065, U = 0.02, U^- = 1.2, V^hnd = 0.01, lags [41, 41], dbar = 20 ms

fb_law_check.closure_bit: CLOSE relayed by the simulator (instants tcl recorded), inert: no schedule pieces, so it starts no schedule clock

settling_time.note: first-to-last stop interval (stopping-time dispersion) vs sum_k q_k

stop_offsets.note: max_i |tau_i - tau_r|, tau_r = T_xi + v^xi/a_b, vs eps_v/a_b + sum_k q_k

stops_after_T_xi.note: no unit stops before the handoff (velocity floor, C4)

marker_error_units.note: per unit: head term + sum of the gap bounds ahead

clearance_floor_pairs.note: g_i = c_i - s_m (intersample minimum) vs g_min,i (C9a)

barrier_floor_acquisition.note: min h_i on [0, t^sw_i] (1 ms record) vs h*^(1)_min + h~_i(0) - H^(1)_i (C9b)

barrier_floor_s2.note: min h_i on [t^sw_i, T_xi) (1 ms record) vs h*^(2)_min + h~_i(0) - H^(1)_i - H^(2)_i (C9b)

barrier_braking.note: min h_i from T_xi (1 ms record) vs h*_i(T_xi) + h~_i(0) - H^(1) - H^(2) - H^b

inactivity_margin_pairs.note: u_cbf - u_nom (event left limits included) vs sigma_i (C8)

command_upper.note: every applied command before LATCH <= U

nominal_command_upper.note: every nominal command before LATCH <= U (no clipping)

command_lower_before_T_xi.note: min_{t < T_xi} u_i vs min over the cells of P^-_i - F^-_i (C7b)

speed_monotonicity.note: informational: the certificate does not certify nonpositive commands (NONPOS is report-only)

gap_closure.note: FB law: e_i = c_i - d_s,i from takeover (e_i(0) = c_i(0) - d_s,i); the S2 feedback closes the gaps; t_position_band: first instant with |e_i| <= eps_e

phase_extrema.note: phases of the FB run: acquisition [0, last S2 switch]; hardest_deceleration = first reference piece [0, first step); reference_steps [first step, crawl onset]; crawl up to T_xi; braking from T_xi to the last stop; dev = u - a_r

system: FB closed loop (sim_hr.py, schedules=False, nosched=park): continuous local law (T_u = h), RK4 between events, T_m = T_c = 1 ms, constant transport 19 ms, shaped head reference with its steps as head clock events, followers regulating c_i - d_s,i from takeover (COAST, S1, S2 with the received command as feedforward), relayed braking, exact standstill sensing, RULE and LATCH, safety filter on
terminology: settling time = first-to-last stop interval (stopping-time dispersion); tset are the S2 switch (detection) instants, compared with the switch deadlines and the earliest switch instants tlow_sw of the certificate
